mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS and RSAFS both increase by more than 0.5% in the past month, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), a high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 238.0) signals potential central bank reaction and economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, when CPIAUCSL is above 238.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 105.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp in the past month, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 450000.0) signals strong demand and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as late-cycle expansion, when RSAFS is above 450000.0, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
